description: Open-licence fonts for burnburn-text and burnburn-generators tests (IM18 tekstdeel, IM22). Tests load fonts from these bytes only; no system font scan.
golden_policy: Never replace these files automatically. A different font version changes glyph outlines and shaping fixtures; that needs a reviewed explanation (AGENTS.md).

files.origin: Copied 2026-10-18 from the local sibling project ../solidcraft/assets/fonts/liberation-sans/ (its OFL.txt names crates/sketch/fonts/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf). Not downloaded. Liberation Sans 2.x, copyright 2010 Google, 2012 Red Hat.
files.content: Latin primary font: kerning (GPOS), fi/fl ligatures (GSUB), no CJK glyphs.

files.origin: Copied 2026-10-18 from the local sibling project ../solidcraft/assets/fonts/biz-udp-gothic/. Not downloaded. Copyright 2022 The BIZ UDGothic Project Authors (github.com/googlefonts/morisawa-biz-ud-mincho).
files.content: Fallback font in tests: Japanese glyphs that Liberation Sans lacks.

files.licence: Bitstream Vera licence with public-domain DejaVu changes (DejaVuSans-LICENSE.txt); permissive
files.origin: Copied 2026-10-22 (G7-trace), unchanged, from the matplotlib package already on this machine (mpl-data/fonts/ttf/DejaVuSans.ttf, which ships LICENSE_DEJAVU). Not downloaded.
files.content: Arabic test font: isolated, initial, medial and final shapes and the lam-alef ligature through GSUB, combining marks.

files.origin: Copied with the font from matplotlib's LICENSE_DEJAVU.

Copied 2026-10-22 (G8-trace), unchanged, from /System/Library/Fonts/MuktaMahee.ttc on this machine (macOS ships the Ek Type font; its name table says OFL 1.1, copyright 2017 Ek Type). Not downloaded. A font collection of 7 weights; the first face is MuktaMahee Regular.
files.content: Indic test font: Devanagari and Gurmukhi (Mukta covers Devanagari plus its own script), with the Indic GSUB/GPOS rules: pre-base matra reordering, conjuncts, reph. Also the only font collection (.ttc) among the fixtures.

files.origin: Composed 2026-10-22: copyright and licence statement from the font's name table, the standard OFL 1.1 text as in LiberationSans-OFL.txt (the original OFL.txt of Ek Type is not on this machine).
Written 2026-10-18 by Generators/tekst: struct-only reader of head/cmap/hmtx/glyf, independent of skrifa. Not a runtime dependency.
files.content: Prints units per em, glyph ids, advances and glyf bounding boxes used as oracles in burnburn-text tests.
